title: Prepare for Singapore's e-invoicing requirements
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
### Built for Singapore's Five-Corner Peppol Model


Real-time reporting to IRAS demands invoice data that is correct at issuance, because a rejected transmission becomes a filing failure. Singapore's model is distinctive: a five-corner model that adds a direct reporting channel to IRAS as a fifth participant in every transaction.


Vertex enables your organization to:


###


Transmit invoice and reporting data to IRAS simultaneously.


###


Validate against BIS Billing 3.0 and PINT SG formats.


###


Route invoices across B2B, B2C (excluding POS tickets), and B2G transactions.


###


Archive invoices for the required five-year retention period.
